risks.risk: Brakes may be worn or not properly adjusted (pads/cables/hydraulics condition not visible).
risks.proof: Short video of a safe stop test + close-up of both front and rear brake pads/cables (or calipers) showing thickness and alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used bicycles with brakes not guaranteed (worst case: needs adjustment/parts).

risks.risk: Gears may skip or shift poorly under load (shifter/derailleur condition not shown).
risks.proof: Video of shifting through all gears while pedaling (front and rear derailleur movement clearly visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used bicycles with gears not guaranteed (worst case: needs tuning).

risks.risk: Hidden rust/corrosion in chain, hubs, spokes, and under-frame areas.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of chain, cassette/freewheel area, wheel hubs, and underside of frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there may be minor corrosion (worst case: cleaning/maintenance needed).

risks.risk: Tires/tubes may be near end-of-life or have slow leaks (tread and sidewalls not clearly assessed).
risks.proof: Photo of tire tread close-up + check/confirmation of tire pressure and a quick ride test; ideally show no wobble and no bulges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used bikes that may need tire/tube replacement.

risks.risk: Parts may be mixed/replaced (not confirmed as original).
risks.proof: Close-ups of drivetrain components (chainring/cassette/freewheel, derailleur model markings) and brake/lever markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used bicycles with unknown originality.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of front and rear brakes (pads/cables/calipers) for both bikes.
Video test: ride and shift through all gears for both bikes.
Close-up photos of chain + rear cassette/freewheel area for both bikes.
Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls for both bikes (and confirm no bulges).
Any receipt/serial number or brand/model markings clearly shown for each bike.
response.reason: The photo confirms there are two bicycles, but key price drivers (brake and gear working condition, rust/corrosion, tire health, and originality) are not verifiable from the single image. Request short test videos and close-ups before pricing.
